title: Enforce lossless CDA feasibility during SCHC rule selection
description: Post-fix robustness review found rule_matches validates descriptors and MO matching but can select values a CDA cannot reconstruct losslessly. NotSent must require packet value equals target; Lsb must require the elided prefix equals the target prefix, safely at widths/arguments 0 and 128; MappingSent must require membership. Otherwise Ignore/MatchMapping combinations can silently reconstruct a different field. Enforce CDA feasibility independently of MO or reject unsupported pairs, and add round-trip tests across all MO/CDA pairs and 1/128-bit boundaries.
notes: Independent correctness review recommends canonical Python-compatible pairing: NotSent only with Equal; Lsb only with Msb using same mo_arg; MappingSent only with MatchMapping. Built-in rules already use safe pairs. Prefer this strict pair matrix over per-packet feasibility alone for cross-implementation parity.
